scope: ChatGPT and Codex plugin selector interface
rule: @ mention selects a thin routing surface only; live CGX authority, Recovery state, capabilities, tools and minimum-sufficient-work are resolved by the shared handshake.
invariants: No @ mention creates a second agent instance, runtime, filespace or authority.
Agent selectors provide actor/lens defaults; domain selectors provide domain context without transferring authority.
Current Recovery and verifier state are resolved live before execution.
Exact reusable results outrank reconciliation; valid reconciliation outranks missing-only execution; missing-only outranks bounded new execution.
Heavy deterministic work remains on existing LightSpeed/local execution surfaces when available.
